title: Divide Players Into Teams Of Equal Skill
statement:
Given an even-length array `skill`, divide its players into pairs so every pair has the same sum of skills. A pair's chemistry is the product of its two skills. Return the sum of all pair chemistries, or `-1` if no such division is possible.

## Examples

```text
Input: skill = [3, 2, 5, 1, 3, 4]
Output: 22
```

```text
Input: skill = [3, 4]
Output: 12
```

```text
Input: skill = [1, 1, 2, 3]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= skill.length <= 10^5`
- `skill.length` is even.
- `1 <= skill[i] <= 1000`
